rows.en: 13  Atmospheric Entry
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Everyone. Right now, an urgent situation has come up, so let me get straight into the briefing.

<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)><book(12)>Neo Zeon<endbook()>, former <book(18)>Giganos<endbook()>, and the <book(29)>Martian Successors<endbook()> have united<thumbnail(229)> and begun full-scale hostilities against the <book(9)>Federation<endbook()>.
rows.notes: Martian Successors per character_names_021 (org.martian_successors, locked). 'former Giganos' for kyuu-Giganos per character_names_021 role note on the faction. Dropped 'the three of them' (san-sha) to fit the 128-char limit; 'united' used instead of 'joined forces'/'banded together' to avoid the j while staying under 128 chars; thumbnail(229) moved to the equivalent point.

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>In response, the <book(9)>Federation<endbook()>'s countermeasures have been a step behind at every turn.

<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>The <book(24)>terminal colony<endbook()> "<book(26)>Amaterasu<endbook()>" was attacked, and the computing unit that controls the <book(30)>Boson Jump<endbook()> was stolen.
rows.notes: Amaterasu = terminal colony per glossary.json loc entry.

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>And now, using the <book(30)>Boson Jump<endbook()>, they are launching surprise attacks on <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> facilities everywhere.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>And the moment they gained the upper hand, they seized what may be called a symbol of Earth itself - the <book(33)>Macross<endbook()><thumbnail(244)>!
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>The <book(33)>Macross<endbook()>'s internal main computer oversees the <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> forces' military network.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>If they seize control of it, every defense system tied into that military network will fall into their hands.
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>What's more... as you all know, the <book(33)>Macross<endbook()> is a giant warship whose main gun can destroy even an asteroid...
<operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>It is also the political symbol that brought the <book(4)>First Defense War<endbook()> to an end.
rows.notes: Source book(4) span here does include 'dai-ichiji' ('First'); rendered as the locked book(4) term 'First Defense War', consistent with both the literal source and the encyclopedia_022 precedent for this book id.

rows.en: <operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>If they deploy it as a fighting force... the blow we'd take, both material and psychological, would be beyond measure!
rows.notes: Compressed to fit the 128-char limit; meaning unchanged.

rows.en: <thumbdown()><operator(30050,1)><speed(2)>Our forces must throw everything we have into retaking the <book(33)>Macross<endbook()>.
<topic()><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>From here<thumbnail(231)>, we will enter the atmosphere from satellite orbit and head straight for <book(88)>Macross City<endbook()>.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>However, to block our advance, <color(5)>enemy forces<ce()> are deployed in satellite orbit.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>What's more... hacking of the <book(9)>Federation<endbook()>'s military network has progressed, and part of its control has already been seized.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Because of that, the <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> forces' defense systems deployed in satellite orbit are now aiming their guns at us.
<thumbdown()><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>It is an extremely troublesome situation, but we have no choice. Let's force our way through to retake the <book(33)>Macross<endbook()>.
<topic()><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Also, there's one more important announcement.

<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Harry<ce()> and I are heading to the <book(31)>Nergal<endbook()> Dock on the Moon to receive the <book(21)>Nadesico C<endbook()><thumbnail(232)>, so we'll be stepping away for a while.
rows.notes: Harry per character_names_021 (Hari Makibi, en_short Harry, nickname given by Ruri). Nergal per Nergal Heavy Industries (encyclopedia_021_a).

rows.en: <operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>The situation calls for urgency, but the <book(21)>Nadesico C<endbook()> is needed for the battles ahead. We will catch up, so please wait for us.
rows.notes: Compressed to fit the 128-char limit; meaning unchanged.

rows.en: <thumbdown()><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>In exchange... though it may not be much of one, I've already reached out to some former <color(4)>Nadesico crew<ce()>.
rows.notes: 'Nadesico crew' descriptive, referring to the film's Aestivalis pilots (Hikaru Amano, Izumi Maki - see 4003170 slot 30).

rows.en: <operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>They're a bit unusual people, but their skill is certain.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>They are set to link up after we descend to the ground, so please look after them.
rows.notes: 'link up' used in place of 'join up' to avoid the j.

rows.en: <topic()><operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>The <color(4)>Nadesico<ce()>'s absence is a blow, but time is short as well. We're moving out now.
<topic()><operator(30000,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>. Tuning on the <color(4)>Ixbrau<ce()>'s additional parts<thumbnail(247)> is complete.
rows.notes: 'Additional parts' (tsuika parts) kept distinct from the 'refit parts' (kansou parts) of 4003030; different source term. 'Tuning' used in place of 'Adjustments' to avoid the j.

rows.en: <operator(30000,1)><speed(2)>Using these additional parts lets us operate the <color(4)>Ixbrau<ce()> as a fire-support unit.
<operator(30000,1)><speed(2)>But mobility and melee ability drop sharply, so be careful.

uncertainties.issue: 'the three of them' for sansha (Neo Zeon / former Giganos / Martian Successors); descriptive, matches source meaning.

This row's source book(4) span does include 'dai-ichiji' ('First'); book(4) is locked to 'First Defense War' throughout the reviewed corpus (encyclopedia_021_a/022) and also matches this row's literal source (unlike 4003180 slot 22, whose source omits 'dai-ichiji').
'Nadesico crew' is a plain descriptive rendering (no locked term found); it refers to the film's civilian Aestivalis pilots who rejoin in 4003170/4004553 (Hikaru Amano, Izumi Maki).
